'''2014 Match Play Championship Consolation Brian Terwilliger DS Wookiee Slaving Operation''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Terwilliger]] at [[2014 Match Play Championship]] (Consolation).

His Consolation sheet (name box ''BTwigg'', deck name ''DS Better'') lists only changes to his [[2014 Match Play Championship Day 1 Brian Terwilliger DS Wookiee Slaving Operation|Day 1 Dark Side list]]: one column headed ''Adds'' and one headed ''Took out''. Several lines cannot be read with confidence, so the full Consolation list is not rebuilt here. The changes are listed as far as they can be read; the objective is not among them.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Wookiee Slaving Operation / Indentured To The Empire|VB8-D-wookieeslavingoperation-pre.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 9.1]]
* '''Stage:''' Consolation
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
